profile_text.body:
PegaSystems Inc, which presents itself as Pega, describes itself as a leading AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation. In its own words, organizations use Pega to reimagine work by automating workflows, personalizing customer experiences, and modernizing legacy systems, and the company says it has served large organizations since 1983. It states that its AI is grounded in best practices with governance built in, and that its AI agents operate with context, compliance, and human oversight. Products named on the site are Pega Platform, which the company describes as unifying AI for mission-critical work, and Pega Blueprint, described as an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together.

The company is a public company traded under the ticker PEGA and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001013857.

Held records list no lawsuits, no tracked products, and no MCP servers for the company. Its recorded law exposure is in Massachusetts, with a count of 191.
